RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-male panel is worth noting, but it does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Assigning a percentage would imply evidence we don’t have.

Your qualifications justify asking how the criteria were applied. Industry experience, interview performance and departmental needs might legitimately outweigh publication counts—unless, for example, a completed PhD was mandatory.

Follow up now for the written explanation, advertised criteria and any available scoring or panel-composition policy. You can raise the panel’s composition neutrally as a procedural concern, rather than an accusation. If the explanation reveals inconsistent criteria, unequal treatment or policy breaches, consider formal review. Check local complaint deadlines while awaiting a response.
